official_documentation_mapping_not_appli.distance_precision: Maximum positioning error in metres for random placement within a street/locality; not a generic certified radius for everyXY or a probability.
official_documentation_mapping_not_appli.zonage_quality: qualite_iris/qp24/zus/qp15/qva describe zonal assignment reliability, with1certain,2probable,3imputed-or-undetermined. They are not another interchangeable site-coordinate accuracy scale.
official_documentation_mapping_not_appli.CRS: EPSG is a row/source projection descriptor; metropolitan Lambert93 is2154. Overseas projections differ and cannot be interpreted as metropolitanL93.
official_documentation_mapping_not_appli.source_and_date_limits: The statistical geocoder combines RIL, fiscal addresses/cadastre and BAN. Same-commune address corrections can update annually, versus monthly commune changes. It is published for statistical studies, separately from reference stocks. These facts concern this distinct source, not a proven row-level origin/error of current August stockXY.
official_documentation_mapping_not_appli.no_centroid_claim: Official code33 means random commune imputation, NOT necessarily the commune centroid. Codes12/22 mean random street placement, not a house point. No particular current candidate was inspected/classified, and no existing coordinate is declared false.
